tutor.answer:
Context engineering is about curating the optimal set of tokens in the model's context window at inference time, whereas prompt engineering is about writing and organising instructions — prompt engineering is one row inside context engineering [PEID-3.2]. The unit of work grows from the string you type to everything in the window, it is re-decided every turn by the application, and the typical failure becomes "the model lacks the fact or drowns in facts" rather than "the model misunderstood" [PEID-3.2].

The term spread within days in June 2025: Shopify's CEO Tobi Lütke said he preferred it to

Published 2026 per-resolution rates in customer service differ about fourfold for nominally the same unit: roughly $0.50 at HubSpot, $0.99 at Fin, $1.50 at Zendesk and $2.00 at Salesforce Agentforce [DTGS-3.15]. HubSpot also cut its price from $1.00 per conversation to $0.50 per resolved conversation in April 2026, while Sierra built its whole business on pure outcome pricing and 11x charges per booked meeting rather than per seat [DTGS-3.15].

The key caveat is that the rates are not directly comparable, because the definition of the billable unit is the whole bill: one vendor's "resolution"
